concepts.title: Polar decomposition of a bounded Hilbert-space operator
concepts.description: Every bounded operator J between Hilbert spaces has a factorization J=U(J*J)¹ᐟ² with a partial isometry U whose initial space is the closure of the range of J*. Equivalently J=(JJ*)¹ᐟ²U.

concepts.title: Spectral theorem for bounded self-adjoint operators
concepts.description: A bounded self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space has a unique projection-valued spectral measure, supported on its real spectrum, representing the operator and its bounded Borel functional calculus.

concepts.title: Branching diffusion killed at the boundary of a domain
concepts.description: Particles move independently as a specified diffusion in D, are killed upon leaving D, and independently branch at rate β into A offspring at their current positions; offspring repeat the same dynamics independently. Start from a specified finite configuration.

concepts.title: Many-to-few lemma for constant-rate branching Markov processes
concepts.description: Let Q_k be the multiple-spine law with unchanged motion, m_j=EAʲ, and let D_s(v) count marks on a skeleton particle v alive at s. For nonnegative measurable F of k terminal particle positions (or their ancestral paths), E_P∑_{(u₁,…,u_k)∈N_tᵏ}F(u₁,…,u_k)=E_{Q_k}[F(ξ¹,…,ξᵏ)exp{β∫₀ᵗ∑_{v marked alive at s}(m_{D_s(v)}−1)ds}]. Offspring moments through k are finite; repeated labels are included. Killed marks contribute zero. This is the unchanged-motion specialization of the full Harris–Roberts lemma.

concepts.title: Many-to-one lemma for constant-rate branching Markov processes
concepts.description: If particles branch independently at rate β with mean offspring m and move by a killed Markov semigroup P_tᴰ, then E_x∑_{u∈N_t}f(X_u(t))=e^{β(m−1)t}P_tᴰf(x) for nonnegative measurable f.

concepts.title: Many-to-two second-moment formula for branching Markov processes
concepts.description: For rate-β branching with offspring mean m and finite factorial second moment q=E[A(A−1)], set T_tf=e^{β(m−1)t}P_tᴰf. Then E_x[(∑_uf(X_u(t)))(∑_ug(X_u(t)))]=T_t(fg)(x)+βq∫₀ᵗT_s[(T_{t−s}f)(T_{t−s}g)](x)ds for bounded nonnegative f,g.

concepts.title: Additive-martingale spine change of measure for a branching diffusion
concepts.description: Weight the branching law up to t by M_t/M₀, where M_t=e^{(λ−β(m−1))t}∑_uφ(X_u(t)). Under the weighted law a distinguished lineage moves by the φ-ground-state transform, branches at accelerated rate mβ with size-biased offspring law kP(A=k)/m, and chooses one child uniformly to continue the spine; other children start independent original branching families.

concepts.title: Brownian bridge on a finite interval
concepts.description: The centered Gaussian process β_t=B_t−(t/T)B_T,0≤t≤T, with endpoints zero and covariance min(s,t)−st/T. A bridge from x to y adds x+(t/T)(y−x).

concepts.title: Brownian-bridge sampling of discrete Brownian paths
concepts.description: Generate a Brownian path on a finite grid by first sampling its endpoint, then recursively sampling an interior value conditional on already generated bracketing values using its Gaussian bridge law.

concepts.title: Standard Brownian motion
concepts.description: A continuous process B_t starting at zero with independent increments and B_t−B_s distributed N(0,t−s) for 0≤s<t. A d-dimensional standard Brownian motion has d independent standard components.

concepts.title: Quadratic covariation of Brownian coordinates
concepts.description: For coordinates of standard multidimensional Brownian motion, [B^i,B^j]_t=δ_{ij}t almost surely, simultaneously for all t≥0.

concepts.title: Reflection principle for Brownian motion
concepts.description: For standard Brownian motion, a≥0 and measurable A⊆(−∞,a), P(max_{s≤t}B_s≥a,B_t∈A)=P(B_t∈2a−A). Reflection of the path after first hitting a preserves Wiener measure.

concepts.title: Strong Markov property of Brownian motion
concepts.description: At every almost surely finite stopping time T, the process B_{T+t}−B_T is a standard Brownian motion independent of the information through time T.

concepts.title: Burkholder–Davis–Gundy inequality in L²
concepts.description: For a continuous local martingale M with M₀=0 and a stopping time T, E[M]_T≤E sup_{s≤T}|M_s|²≤4E[M]_T, with expectations allowed infinite and [M] its quadratic variation. The finite case follows by localization.

concepts.title: C¹ domain in Euclidean space
concepts.description: An open connected subset of ℝᵈ whose boundary near every point can, after a rigid change of coordinates, be written as the graph of a C¹ function, with the domain locally on one side.

concepts.title: Continuously differentiable Euclidean map
concepts.description: A map on an open Euclidean set whose first coordinate partial derivatives exist and are continuous.

concepts.title: C¹,¹ domain in Euclidean space
concepts.description: A C¹ domain whose local boundary graph functions have Lipschitz continuous first derivatives.

concepts.title: Càdlàg path
concepts.description: A path from a real time interval into a metric space that is right-continuous and has a left limit at every positive time.
